ART COMMISSION AGREEMENT (v2026-10-01)

Between The Crow's Quill (the Artist, contact@crowsquill.art) and Test Author Stripe (test-stripe@example.com), for Stripe Test Chronicles.

THE COMMISSION
The Artist will create the artwork described in the commission brief submitted through the website and any later changes agreed by both parties in writing. The brief and supplied references form part of this agreement. All characters depicted must be fictional adults aged 18 or over.
Commission type: Portrait — 1 character
Agreed price: $100.00 USD (50% booking payment of $50.00)
Licence: Author Promotional Licence

FINAL FILES
The Client will receive the agreed finished digital artwork in the appropriate high-resolution format, plus any additional versions specifically agreed. Working files, layered files, sketches and source files are not included unless separately agreed.

PAYMENT
A 50% booking payment is due before work begins. The remaining 50% is due before the final high-resolution artwork is delivered. Payment plans may be agreed for larger commissions. If the Client requests work outside the agreed brief, the Artist will confirm any additional cost before carrying out that work. The Client's usage licence begins once the commission has been paid for in full.

PROCESS & REVISIONS
The Artist will provide a sketch for approval before completing the final artwork. The commission includes two rounds of changes at sketch stage and minor corrections at final stage. One revision round means one consolidated set of requested changes. Once the sketch has been approved, major changes to the pose, composition, clothing, characters, setting or other agreed elements may incur an additional fee. Changes required because the Artist has not followed the agreed brief do not count as revisions.

TIMESCALE
Estimated completion: around 20 Oct 2026. The Client agrees to provide required information, references and feedback within a reasonable time. If required information or feedback is delayed, the completion date may also move. Any fixed deadline must be agreed before the commission begins.

CANCELLATION
Either party may cancel the commission before completion. If the Client cancels after work has begun, the Artist may retain payment reasonably reflecting the work already completed and any reasonable loss resulting from the cancellation. Any remaining amount will be refunded where applicable. If the Artist is unable to complete the commission, the Client will be refunded for any part of the commission paid for but not supplied. Cancelled or unfinished artwork may not be used by the Client unless separate written permission is given. Either party may end an active commission where the other engages in abusive, threatening or seriously inappropriate behaviour toward the other.

COPYRIGHT
Copyright in the finished artwork remains with the Artist. The Client retains all rights they hold in their characters, books, series, world, text and other underlying intellectual property. Commissioning the artwork does not transfer ownership of either party's underlying intellectual property to the other. The Artist will not sell, license or otherwise commercially exploit commissioned artwork depicting the Client's original characters without the Client's permission.

USAGE LICENCE
Author Promotional Licence (included): the Client may use the finished artwork to promote the relevant book, characters or series, including social media, websites, newsletters, paid advertising, retailer graphics, character reveals, launch and preorder graphics, events and displays, banners, and free bookmarks, postcards, art cards, preorder gifts, reader swag and other promotional material given away free. The Client may crop, resize and add text where reasonably required for promotional use.
Commercial Merchandise Licence (only if selected in the quote; flat fee of 50% of the original artwork cost): permits reproduction of the finished artwork on products offered for sale. Copyright remains with the Artist and the Client may not sell, transfer or license the artwork itself to another person or business.
Publishing use (covers, dust jackets, endpapers, interior illustrations, special-edition components) is quoted separately and agreed in writing before completion.

ARTIST PORTFOLIO & PROMOTION
The Artist may display the finished artwork on their website, portfolio and social media to promote their work. Where an embargo or reveal date has been agreed in the brief, the Artist will not publicly share the artwork before that date. If no embargo has been agreed, the Artist may share the finished artwork after delivery to the Client.

AI & ALTERATION
The Client may not use the artwork to train generative AI systems or upload the artwork to generative AI services for the purpose of creating replacement or derivative artwork. The Client may not repaint, redraw, retouch, recolour or otherwise alter the artwork without the Artist's written permission.

CREDIT
Where credit is reasonably practical, the Artist's preferred credit is "Art by The Crow's Quill". Credit is appreciated when the artwork itself is being showcased, but is not required on every advertisement, promotional graphic or physical item on which the artwork appears.

Signed electronically by Test Author Stripe on 02 Oct 2026 13:32 UTC.
